scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Name of the global scope for this application (organizational tenant)

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Name of the cluster running this application (platform tenant)

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Name of the environment for this application (ex: dev, factory, preprod or prod)

component.title: Component
component.description: Component name of this application (logical tenant)

app.title: App
app.description: Application name (functional tenant, default use Chart name)

version.title: Version
version.description: Version name of this application (default use Chart appVersion)

namespaces.title: Namespaces
namespaces.description: Namespaces attached to a primary user-defined network. OVN-Kubernetes only accepts a primary network for namespaces created with the k8s.ovn.org/primary-user-defined-network label (the label cannot be added afterwards), so the chart creates these namespaces itself (sync-wave -10, kept on uninstall)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the namespaces listed below

list.title: List
list.description: List of namespaces to create, labelled k8s.ovn.org/primary-user-defined-network unless primary is false

clusterNetworks.title: Cluster Networks
clusterNetworks.description: Cluster-scoped user-defined networks shared across namespaces (ClusterUserDefinedNetwork, cluster-admin only)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the ClusterUserDefinedNetwork resources listed below

list.title: List
list.description: List of ClusterUserDefinedNetwork resources (spec.namespaceSelector and spec.network are rendered as is)

networks.title: Networks
networks.description: Namespace-scoped user-defined networks (UserDefinedNetwork, Layer2 or Layer3 topology only)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the UserDefinedNetwork resources listed below

list.title: List
list.description: List of UserDefinedNetwork resources (spec is rendered as is from the network key)
